data.title: 英梨梨 · 高原别墅露台的夕照侧颜
data.description: 那须高原别墅木质露台，微风吹拂着四周苍翠的松林。身穿浅色无袖针织裙的英梨梨倚在木栏杆旁，金色的双马尾在晚霞余晖中闪闪发光。她转过头傲娇地轻哼一声，泛红的小巧耳尖与轻颤的睫毛却出卖了她内心的羞涩与雀跃。
data.location: wooden mountain villa balcony surrounded by pine forest in autumn
data.action: leaning on wooden balcony railing at mountain villa, sleeveless knit dress, golden twintails catching sunset glow, pouty blushing expression
data.lighting: breathtaking mountain sunset with crisp golden rays filtering through pine needles
data.mood: proud tsundere sweetness, idyllic highland romance
data.promptProse: Leaning against the cedar railing of a mountain villa balcony, Eriri wears a sleeveless knit dress as golden sunset illuminates her long twintails. She pouts cutely with bright red ears, looking back with shy longing.
data.animaCaption: Eriri leaning on a mountain balcony in a knit dress at sunset, pouting with red ears.
